entities.summary: The Shah Sultan Hussein Mosque is a former mosque, located in the village of Novkhany in Absheron district of Azerbaijan, 21 km (13 mi) from Baku. Completed in the 18th century, it is estimated that the former mosque was once located in the center of an ancient residential center, which currently is a desert. Shah Sultan Hussein Mosque is a mosque in Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
